criteria.requirement: Add parse handler option namespace_collision="merge"|"error". Preserve existing merge default; error rejects when different expanded element names under the same parent or distinct expanded attributes on one element collapse to one mapped dictionary key through namespaces. Repeated identical expanded names remain valid lists, and equal local keys under separate parents are independent. Check before postprocessor transformations; do not classify ordinary repeats or user postprocessor collisions as namespace collisions. Support item_depth streaming, inherited maps and prefix remapping without global state.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
